text: 康希诺发布公告，股票于2026年9月28日、9月29日及9月30日连续3个交易日内日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过30%，根据《上海证券交易所交易规则》《上海证券交易所科创板股票异常交易实时监控细则》的有关规定，属于股票交易异常波动情形。公司关注到近期市场上关于mRNA技术的发展，海外mRNA肿瘤疫苗临床阶段性数据发布或计划公开。
text_en: CanSino announced that the cumulative deviation of the daily closing price of its stock exceeded 30% over three consecutive trading days on September 28, September 29, and September 30, 2026. According to the relevant provisions of the Shanghai Stock Exchange Trading Rules and the Shanghai Stock Exchange Rules for Real-Time Monitoring of Abnormal Trading on the STAR Market, this constitutes abnormal stock trading fluctuation. The company noted recent market attention to the development of mRNA technology and the release or planned disclosure of phased clinical data for overseas mRNA cancer vaccines.
